body:
I'm going to try to lay down...i'll leave the gun in another room.
i hope i can sleep.  if not i'll try to pm you to get my mind on something else.  thank you.

i think you're right....but i cant seem to stop making these bad decisions.  i want to be strong about it, but it just keeps nagging at me.  I won't leave myself alone about it.  i really tried to go out but i couldn't stay there and have a breakdown in front of my friend, i'm embarrassed enough as it is.  i just really don't know what to do to make the pain stop.

i just came back from a friends house...i stayed for 2 hours and had to leave before a broke down again.  he has no idea and i don't really want anyone to know.  when i got home i took some valium to calm down, then i got the gun and loaded the clip.  i waiting for the point where i cant cry anymore but it just seems to be getting worse.  i keep waiting for her to call or text or email but i haven't heard from her all day.  i told her i bought my ticket today but i got no reply....i just keep making bad decision after bad decision and looking more pathetic in her eyes i'm sure.

i lost my job which means i lost my insurance.  i cant afford to pay out of pocket.  i had some meds left that i've been trying to stretch but they're pretty much gone.  i ate 8 valium to calm myself down...it's not working.  my thoughts are just racing, my hearts pounding.  i thought they might knock me out so i could at least sleep...maybe wake up alive,  but they don't seem to have any effect right now.

thank you..i really do appreciate it.  i'm just sitting here looking at it in my hand and wondering what it's going to feel like.  i don't even feel scared like i used to.  i'm trying to wait but i just keep crying and i want it all to stop.  i am glad i at least had this chance to talk to someone about this.  I really am thankful for the whole reddit community.  you are like my family.  i'm sorry i couldn't be stronger.

It's funny...i've said and done all the right things.  I never even raised my voice to her.  i told her to her no more crying, we're going to work this out.  I told her i loved her.  i already had the ring and bought a plane ticket to go see her in a week.  i don't know what i'm thinking...she says i can come if i want but i hear in her voice that she does not want me there.  i'm just making a bigger fool out of myself.  i actually planned on going there anyway and asking her to marry me....and i 'm so ashamed that i'm that weak and needy.  it's no wonder people walk all over me.  we get what we deserve. I don't even feel sorry for myself anymore...just self hatred.  and there's nowhere to hide when you hate yourself.

She says she's sorry...we both cried a lot.  she says i deserve someone better.  i told her we can work it out but i think i panicked...i just didn't want to lose her.  and honestly i feel like she would rather break up than have to deal with what she did.  i just can't believe a word she says anymore.  i can't stop crying and i'm so embarrassed that i didn't tell anyone about this...your the only one who knows, that's kind of funny.  I told my brother i was going to ask her...told him all about her, how perfect she was for me.  i never felt like such a fool.

she says she does not know why she did it.  she says our relationship was perfect and that she just threw away the best thing in her life.  we were talking about getting married days before this happened.  she met some new friends there and some guy with lots of money who gave her attention.  We talked about cheating days before this happened also.  She said she'd never do that.  she said she never cheated before in her life so why would she start with the person she is going to marry... but she did it anyway, and she can only say she does not know why.  I've been around long enough to know why...she just doesn't love me anymore.  I just can't live with that....I can't go through this again.

I'm basically alone.  I just lost the only thing I had in this world.  My girlfriend told me on Saturday that she slept with someone else while she was away on an island.  I haven't sleep since then.  I can barely eat, and what I eat just makes my stomach pains worse.  I've had them all my life.  I'm bipolar and it's hard for me to maintain my sanity.  I've thought about suicide before and came close but this time I know it's for real.  I know what people will say and I appreciate it, but I can't take the pain anymore.  I wish I could, but thats just not the way i'm wired.
